meta.title: Escalation Timeout (Hours) (approval.escalation.timeout_hours) = 48 (default)
gaps: Trigger approvals through condition-based triggering such as value or category.
Observe a pending approval for 48 hours and verify it auto-escalates to the next level exactly at the configured timeout.
Verify the 1–720 hour boundary behavior and business impact in the approval workflow.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Trigger approvals through condition-based triggering such as value or category.; Observe a pending approval for 48 hours and verify it auto-escalates to the next level exactly at the configured timeout.; Verify the 1–720 hour boundary behavior and business impact in the approval workflow.

steps.note: Set the tenant approval escalation timeout to 48 and verify the setting through the supported tenant-setting mechanism.

args.need: trigger a condition-based approval as a Tenant Admin, leave it pending, and verify that it auto-escalates to the next level after exactly 48 hours

steps.note: The catalog has no approval-triggering or timed escalation observation step, so the tester must perform and observe this workflow.
Confirm the current screen remains free of application errors after the tester completes the unavailable workflow.
